title: The Gay Nineties in America
description: From a vantage point 100 years later, one can look back on the excitement and ferment of a turbulent decade and find the seeds of the joys and anguish, the excesses and successes of the twentieth century. Whether for browsing or research, readers will reap rewards from this entertaining and enlightening alphabetical compendium of the persons, events, institutions, and ideas of the era. Taking the emergence of modern American literature--with realism and naturalism replacing romanticism--as his point of view, Robert L. Gale profiles some ninety-five writers of classic and popular literature, journalism, and criticism, 140 individual works, and thirty magazines, all set against the background of America thrusting itself into the twentieth century and evolving as a world power. But he doesn't stop there. Also represented in over 500 entries are painters and politicians, social workers and industrialists, composers and inventors, explorers and evangelists as well as topics like crime, immigration, medicine, motion pictures, sports, and universities and landmark events like the Panic of 1893, the Spanish-American War, and the World's Columbian Exposition. Fully cross-referenced and indexed, the dictionary includes a chronology of events from 1888 to 1901, an appendix classifying entries on key people in occupational and other categories, and an extensive bibliography. Starting on page one or dipping in at any point in the dictionary, the reader will be led to related materials and, finally, to an understanding of this formative period in American cultural history.

Repayment comes in the form of a beautiful but haunted young woman. The light in her tempts the darkness inside of me. Teases it, tortures it. I want to hurt her. I want to break her. I want to keep her. Lucky for Celia she fails to see that there is no goodness in me and when she attempts to draw me in with her innocence, and sweet, naive heart I thrive to show her the cruel monster I am. **This is a dark mafia romance that contains non-con/dub con, graphic violence, and sexual themes. It will always be a no. But the longer I tail her-and the guard dog she brought along-the more I realize something's off. I know I should leave it alone. Amalia's not my problem or my responsibility-and she's no doubt capable of taking care of herself. So why can't I walk away? Salvatore D'Montez, "the capo di tutti i capi" of the Italian Mafia, is known to be inhumane. He had an awful past, and the only person who got his heart was killed right before him. A saying goes like this "Mafia bosses don't deserve a happy ending." After that tragedy, he wouldn't let anyone in. But hey! Fate can be a little tricky. It contains dark themes, including violence and sexual situations. As always there is no cheating, and a happily ever after.*

title: Luciano
description: Luciano Vitale. Grausam. Herzlos. Gnadenlos. Ein Krimineller. Ein Monster. Ein brutaler Killer. Belles und Mobsters, versprochene schöne Frauen und Mafiosi, gehören nicht zusammen. Trotzdem habe ich mich in ihn verliebt, nur um mein Herz von ihm in Stücke reißen zu lassen. Aber ich habe meine Lektion gelernt. Mit nichts als der Kleidung am Leib, einem Rucksack und meiner besten Freundin an der Seite musste ich fliehen. Wir versteckten uns und fingen zusammen ein ganz neues Leben an. Gerade, als unser Leben wieder normal wurde, hat man uns gefunden und in die grausame Unterwelt zurückgezerrt. Diesmal jedoch steht sehr viel mehr auf dem Spiel. Und es ist keine Option, mich unterkriegen zu lassen. Wenn er nur nicht mein Untergang wäre ...

title: Savage Obsession
description: She blames him for the worst night of her life. He doesn't remember her at all Elena Marcelli swore she'd never return to New York—not after her brother's murder seven years ago. But desperation has a short memory. With her mother dying and her toddler's future on the line, she takes the only job that pays enough to survive: live-in nanny for a wealthy Manhattan family. She doesn't expect to find Nicolas Belvedere waiting behind the penthouse door. Cold. Dangerous. Untouchable. The eldest son of one of the city's most notorious crime families. The man who stood in the shadows the night her brother died. He doesn't recognize her. She can't forget him. But when threats close in and bullets start flying, Elena becomes the only person Nicolas trusts. And he becomes the only place she feels safe. In a world built on lies and bloodshed, can two broken souls find redemption in each other's arms—or will the truth about that night destroy them both? One-click now to dive into this dark, emotional mafia romance where obsession meets salvation.

title: THE MAFIA DON'S WICKED UNION
description: Are you ready to be swept away into a world where love is a battlefield and danger lurks around every corner? I never asked to fall in love with a man like Lorenzo Moretti—an untouchable mafia boss with blood on his hands and secrets buried in shadows. But when fate pulls you into his world, there’s no escaping the fire. In THE MAFIA DON'S WICKED UNION I—Valentina Russo—am caught between loyalty, love, and survival. Betrayal runs deep in my veins, and every step I take with Lorenzo feels like walking on a razor’s edge. He might be the man I once loved, but can I ever forgive him for the past? Or will our love unravel the threads of everything we thought we knew? When tragedy strikes, I’m thrust into a world of passion, revenge, and cosmic fate that spans across timelines—where love doesn’t just change lives, it rewrites them. Now, everything I thought I knew about my life is being tested. Can I trust the man who holds my heart and my life in his hands? And more importantly, can we survive the love that threatens to destroy everything? Why read this book? A heart-pounding, enemies-to-lovers tale: Get ready for a mafia romance that will leave you breathless. Cosmic love and twists: Time isn’t the only thing at risk; our love spans multiple worlds, multiple lives. A powerful female lead: Valentina is fierce, vulnerable, and relentless in her pursuit of love, justice, and truth. A forbidden romance: Dive into a love that is so passionate, it could tear the world apart—or save it. What’s at stake? A war across realities. The choices we make will either destroy us... or set us free. And in the end, one thing is certain—no one escapes the consequences of loving a mobster. Who needs to read this? Fans of dark, thrilling mafia romance with a twist of destiny, parallel worlds, and impossible love. If you crave tension, suspense, and a love that defies time and space, this story is for you. When should you start reading? Right now. Because when reality is hanging by a thread, and love is the only thing worth fighting for, you can’t afford to wait. Ready to dive into a world where love and chaos collide?THE MAFIA DON'S WICKED UNION is waiting for you. Don’t miss out—your next obsession starts now.

title: The Hunt in Elusion
description: Enjoy this FREE spicy mafia romance series starter by USA Today Bestselling dark romance author M.L. Philpitt... Fairy tales and reality are concepts so different from one another, they shouldn’t exist in the same world. The story in which the maid defies her stepmother, goes to the ball, and dances with the prince isn’t how real life works. For Della Lambert, real life is disappointing. Real life means working for her stepfather in exchange for her and her sister’s freedom. Attend the party, steal their secrets, and lure the mafia prince in. Nico Corsetti isn’t a prince though. He’s the callous Capo who hunts his prey until he’s satisfied in his vengeance. When Della becomes his target, he won’t stop chasing her, even when her betrayal demands her death. In the end, real life isn’t a fairy tale and the prince is simply another controlling villain. The Hunt in Elusion is an enemies to lovers mafia romance between the mafia capo and the woman who becomes his undoing. Expect a spicy Cinderella inspired romance packed full of betrayal and secrets amidst the Montreal mafia. The Hunt in Elusion has content some readers may find triggering. It is the first book in Fractured Ever Afters, a series of interconnected standalones that are best read in order.

title: The Mafia Bodyguard's Possession
description: Some Men Save You. Mine Owns Me. The gunfight in the shipyard should have killed me. Instead, Declan Murphy, the gorgeous Irish mafia enforcer I destroyed, becomes the only thing standing between me and a bullet. He's brutal, unforgiving, and unforgettable. Years ago, I had the tattooed savage arrested just to make him hurt the way he hurt me. Now he's got me pinned in a stolen car, the barrel of a gun tracing every curve of my body, extracting confessions I can't afford to give. My father's disappeared into the underworld, and the secrets I'm chasing could get us both executed. But Declan doesn't do mercy. He does possession. And every scorching touch, every whispered threat, every moment he keeps me trapped against him reminds me why I fell so hard before-and why I'll never escape him now. He should be my enemy. But when his fingers replace the gun and his mouth claims my throat, my body betrays every ounce of hate I've built. The war between our families is coming. The men hunting my father are closing in. And I'm caught between the devil I know and the darkness that wants me dead. Declan Murphy didn't save my life. He made it his. A standalone dark mafia romance featuring an Irish alpha hero, forced marriage, scorching enemies-to-lovers tension, and an HEA worth fighting for. Author Note: This book contains graphic, mature, and explicit content not meant for anyone under 18. There is a full trigger listing in the book.

title: Forbidden Captor
description: How can that jerk think for ONE second that he can seduce me? Oh, cause he's hot (like... insanely ripped) and sexy and older? Yeah well, he's also the one who abducted me! Jack's only job was to kidnap me from my penthouse and bring me to the Reeds family Which he did. When the King Mafia attacks the location where I'm being held hostage to save me, he and I get stuck under the rubble for hours. and the unthinkable happens. We fall for each other. Hard. I didn't stand a chance, with his big hands, strong arms, and piercing eyes. Did I mention? Insanely hot... When I'm rescued and Jack is left for dead, I fight teeth and nails to get back to him and save him. But I'm forced back in my secured building. How will I ever be able to get over him? How will I ever know if he's still alive? Forbidden Captor is a steamy mafia romance, that contains no cheating or abuse. Just a great HEA.

title: Forced Marry To The Mafia King
description: In a deep, rough voice, he says, "I am the one whose brother died because of you." "Sign it... or I shoot." My hands tremble as I take the pen, tears blurring my vision, yet I have no choice but to sign. "From today onward, you are dead to the world." His tone is slow, poisonous. "Your breath belongs to me." "Your life... your death... all in my hands." "Everything you are... is mine." I am trapped in a marriage I never wanted. For him, this marriage is just a deal, a way to increase his power. For me, it is a living hell. He is the Mafia King, ruthless, terrifying, and stone-hearted. He believes I am guilty, and for him, this marriage is not a relationship but a punishment. A crime I never committed, yet he turns me into a criminal and takes revenge every moment for his brother's death. This is not a marriage. It is a fate worse than death. Every day, I live as someone who is already dead to the world. Every night, I suffer under his control for a sin that was never mine. But as the truth slowly begins to surface, everything starts to change. Will I escape this nightmare, or will I be destroyed by the man who controls my life?

title: Callous
description: Callie Reyes: What would you do if you woke up on a superyacht, but you had no memory of how you got there? Yeah, well, welcome to my life. The Carillo brothers think they can keep me. Use me as collateral against my father in their war. But I'm stronger than that. And the Carillo brothers need to be careful. I'm not some wallflower, that's for sure. I bite. Although, there's something about Kane that I can't seem to stay away from... Kane Carillo: What would you do if you seduced the wrong girl, but loved it enough that you wanted to do it again? Callie Reyes is the daughter of our biggest enemy, and my brother and I plan to use her to our advantage. But I need to remind myself that her pretty green eyes are luring me in with their deceit. That she's bad for me. She needs to be reminded that I'm the bad guy. The one they warn you about. I bite. Although, I can't seem to stop myself from finding ways to be alone with her... **This is book #1 in the first Fire Duet, comes with a trigger warning and ends with a cliffhanger.** **This title was previously published as Chasing Fire. Plot & scenes are unchanged.**

title: KING OF VENGEANCE
description: He believes she witnessed his father’s murder. She knows the truth could destroy everything he was born to rule. Dante Valenti has spent his life preparing for betrayal. Cold, controlled, and feared throughout Chicago, he trusts no one outside his family, especially Elena Moretti, the woman found beside his dying father with blood on her hands and a broken-crown coin hidden in her palm. Elena did not kill Salvatore Valenti. But proving her innocence means exposing a secret connected to her missing father, a hidden ledger, and a conspiracy buried deep inside the Valenti empire. When Dante forces Elena into a binding union to keep her close, their hatred becomes a dangerous battle of wills. She refuses to surrender. He refuses to let her escape. Yet behind locked doors and whispered threats, suspicion begins to burn into desire, and the woman he intended to control becomes the only person capable of seeing the man beneath his ruthless name. As enemies close in and family loyalties fracture, Dante and Elena must decide whether trust is worth the blood it may cost. Because the real traitor is closer than either of them imagined, and the truth will not merely change who controls the city. It will decide whether they survive each other. A gripping story of betrayal, obsession, forbidden desire, deadly secrets, and two wounded hearts fighting for freedom. Perfect for readers who enjoy possessive antiheroes, strong heroines, criminal dynasties, high-stakes suspense, and emotionally intense love stories. A complete standalone story within the Mafia Lords in Love series, with a guaranteed happy ending. Enter the Valenti empire today.

title: Claimed by the Mafia King
description: When Nathan Peers walked into my life, I hated him instantly. He is the very man I despise -rich, arrogant, cold and used to getting his way. But when he offered to save my daughter's life in exchange for my servitude, I couldn't afford to say no. Living under Nathan's roof is a nightmare I wasn't prepared for. His every command is designed to humiliate me, pushing me into a submissive role I never imagined myself in. His presence sets my nerves on edge. Yet, beneath my hatred simmers a dangerous attraction. His smoldering gaze, the way he invades my space, the fire his touch ignites-it's intoxicating. I hate him for making me feel this way, for awakening a side of me I never knew existed. The lines between hate and desire blur with every moment we share, and resisting him feels impossible. But surrendering? That would mean losing everything I've fought to protect-including my heart. How do I fight someone I can't resist? Claimed by the Mafia King is a steamy, submissive enemies to lovers romance where a strong-willed woman is torn between hatred and irresistible desire for the man she despises.

title: Public Enemies
description: James Mottram traces the history of the gangster film genre, providing background information on key actors, directors and crew whilst discussing and examining a range of films from the 1930s through to films like Pulp Fiction and Goodfellas.

title: Ruthless Reign
description: From USA Today Bestselling Authors S.R. Watson and Ryan Stacks, comes an enemies to lovers dark mafia romance that is intense, twisted, and binge worthy. Ruthless. Relentless. Feared. As an Italian Mafia boss, I reign superior over the underworld of New York, or so I'm told. As a man whose life has just been reset after awakening without my memories, I'm in a vulnerable state. I only have my backstory from my consigliere to go on. I'm in a precarious position as I fight to remember my true identity-all while hiding my amnesia from my men and my enemies. Giana De Luca is an Italian princess who is by my side when I awake from my induced coma. She is ... Mine to Claim Mine to Own Mine to Deflower It doesn't matter that she has been betrothed to me for the past two years. I can't remember my love for her, and thus I'm not the man she fell in love with. I call off our engagement. I don't want to be held hostage by our past. I need to embrace what a new reality may mean for me ... I need to be free to explore what a new version of me may look like. Hurt but determined, Giana remains loyal and refuses to leave my side while I navigate the lessons needed to resume being the man I'm destined to be. My gut warns me that she may be harboring secrets of her own, so what could she be hiding? Nothing is ever as it seems, not even with the people you're supposed to trust the most. Darkness and deception lurk behind every corner, threatening to unravel falsehoods and plots orchestrated to destroy me. Can I uncover the truth before the lies prevail? WARNING: 18+ only. This book contains scenes that may be triggering to some readers. Please read responsibly.

title: Revenge
description: They took everything. I'll take it back in blood. Six years. That's how long they kept me caged for something I didn't- No. Doesn't matter anymore. Six years I've replayed her screams. Six years I've dreamed of their throats beneath my hands. Now I'm free. And every drag of a cigarette, every swallow of whisky, feeds the monster they made. I was a cop once. The good guy. Now I'm the nightmare they never saw coming. Charlee Vega is a complication I didn't plan for. She's a pawn in this rotten game-innocent and in way too deep. But she's the thread that could unravel everything. Or tie me up in knots I'll never escape. I'll burn it all down to get what I came for. And if she gets in the way? God help us both. Vengeance has no mercy. Neither do I.

title: Shadows of Seduction
description: In the deadly world of the Tempesta family, power isn’t just a game—it’s a weapon. Billie never asked for this life, but when her twin brother’s reckless choices leave her trapped in a dangerous web of mafia debt, her only escape is a choice no one should ever have to make: marry one of the four ruthless Tempesta brothers, or bury the only family she has left. Thrown into a week-long trial to decide which of the brothers she will bind her fate to, Billie finds herself drawn to Danny, the enigmatic eldest brother who saved her life years ago—and who now holds her future in his hands. But trust is a luxury in the Tempesta world, and every decision has a cost. As sparks fly between them, betrayal lurks in the shadows, threatening to shatter everything she thought she knew about loyalty, love, and the price of survival. In a world where seduction is as deadly as it is tempting, Billie must navigate forbidden desire, dangerous alliances, and a deadly family legacy. But when love and power collide, can she escape without losing herself? Will Billie surrender to the shadows of seduction, or will she fight to break free? The choice is hers—but is it ever really hers to make?

title: Devil You Know
description: Nic is so much more than The Devil. The night of the auction changes everything. I thought I knew who he was, and what was going to happen next. I had no idea how wrong I was... ***This is a continuation of Devil You Hate and can not be read as a standalone. This book has a HEA***

title: Ruthless Savage
description: He kissed me in the dark — and I thought he was someone else. I was wrong. And now I belong to the most dangerous man in the room. Dorian doesn't take things that aren't his. He's built his entire empire on that principle. Then I walked into his world carrying his enemy's secrets — and everything changed. He calls our arrangement a partnership. I know what it really is. I'm a weapon he wants to aim. A liability he hasn't decided what to do with yet. A woman he keeps looking at like I'm the most complicated problem he's ever wanted to solve. I don't trust men who watch me the way Dorian does. Quiet. Patient. Like he's already decided the outcome and is simply waiting for me to catch up. But his enemy is closing in. The secrets I carry are the only thing standing between Dorian's world and total collapse. And the man who wants what I know will burn everything to get it — including me. The problem with surviving dangerous men is that sometimes you fall for one. And Dorian Savasta is the most dangerous man I've ever met. She came to him as a bargaining chip. She stayed because leaving stopped feeling like surviving. But when his world starts crumbling from the inside — will he trust her enough to let her help him hold it together? A dark mafia romance with: ✦ Enemies-to-lovers ✦ Identical twin / mistaken identity ✦ Morally grey, obsessive hero ✦ Forced proximity & dangerous alliance ✦ Slow burn with explosive payoff ✦ Brotherhood betrayal ✦ HEA guaranteed

title: Violent Leader
description: The city is in chaos, but I thrive in the aftermath. Grief surrounds our family as we bury our father. As the eldest son, leading the clan is my responsibility. The first task on my list; Make the Bratva pay for what they did. I'll take the most precious thing from Spartak and defile her. Viktoria Volkov. Bratva princess and only daughter of the Pakhan. She will pay for the sins of her father. Once I set my eyes on her, sticking to the plan becomes impossible. The Russian beauty calls to my primal urges. My desire for revenge twists into something else entirely. A dark and violent need rises to the surface. I intended to give her back, broken and damaged. I'll break her and make her mine. I'm just not sure I can ever let her go. What will Spartak do once he realizes I'm keeping his princess forever? Violent Leader is the second book in the Chicago Mafia Dons series. This book is a dark mafia romance involving kidnapping, dark themes and certain subjects that may upset the reader. It has no cliff hanger a happily ever after ending, and can be read as a standalone. It features a dark, twisted Irish mob boss who takes what he wants no matter the consequences.

title: Wrong Marriage Right Bride I
description: She saved his life once. Now he may be the man who destroys hers. Amara Bellini was raised to obey. As the daughter of a powerful Italian mafia boss, her life has always belonged to men who smile softly while making cruel decisions. Ten years ago, she found a wounded boy chained beneath her father’s forbidden chapel. She gave him water, stitched his wounds, and left him with her mother’s rosary. Then he disappeared. Now Amara is being sold into a brutal arranged marriage—until she runs straight into the middle of a mafia wedding and finds the boy she never forgot. Luca Vassari is no longer helpless. He is a ruthless don, feared across Italy, standing at the altar beside another woman. But when Amara appears barefoot, bleeding, and hunted, Luca makes a dangerous choice. He marries the wrong bride. Not for love. For revenge. Trapped inside Luca’s glittering world of power, secrets, and enemies, Amara must survive a marriage built on old blood, broken trust, and dangerous obsession. But the more Luca tries to hate her, the harder it becomes to forget the girl who once saved him. In a world where love is a weakness and marriage is war, Amara may be the only woman who can break the don’s heart—or become his greatest obsession. Wrong Marriage Right Bride is a dark Italian mafia arranged marriage romance filled with revenge, betrayal, emotional tension, dangerous desire, and a possessive mafia don who never should have wanted the bride he took. title: Claimed for Life
description: They killed my father, so I married a madman. HoneyHe's twice my age, ridiculously handsome, and filthy rich.It sounds like I found my happily ever after, except that I didn't.I don't really know him, but that's beside the point.He's my husband now, and he expects me to serve him like a king.But I'm not that easy, and I'm not going to drop to my knees at his command.It'll take a lot more than an arranged marriage with a mafia boss to break me.CarterShe thinks this is about her.It's not.I have better things to do than fool around with a younger woman.I need to own her, to control her, and to use her to my advantage.That's what she's here for.That's why I married her.The cards are in my hand now, and I'm about to make the gamble of a lifetime.I just pray it doesn't end with one of us dead.Claimed for Life is a heart-pounding dark mafia romance built on twisted desires, lies, and vengeance. It's not for the faint of heart, and it's certainly not for those who blush at graphic and intense scenes. Enjoy!

title: Unforgiving Heir II
description: UNFORGIVING HEIR – PART 2 A Dark Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance of Betrayal, a Banished Bride, and a Ruthless Don She lost her title. He lost the only woman he ever trusted. But their greatest battle has only just begun. Lucia Bellandi has been cast out from the powerful Caruso family, branded a traitor for crimes she never committed. Alone, hunted, and surrounded by enemies, she must find the strength to survive in a world where every alliance hides another betrayal. Nico Caruso made the impossible choice to protect his empire, but walking away from the woman he loves may become the greatest mistake of his life. As buried secrets begin to surface, disturbing evidence points to a hidden enemy who has been orchestrating every move from the shadows. With loyalty tested, old enemies growing bolder, and danger closing in from every direction, Nico and Lucia are forced onto separate paths—each fighting a war they never chose. Because in the mafia... The deadliest weapon isn't a gun. It's the truth no one wants uncovered. Perfect for readers who love emotionally charged mafia romance filled with dangerous chemistry, shocking betrayals, powerful family dynasties, suspense, and unforgettable twists, Unforgiving Heir – Part 2 raises the stakes in a gripping continuation where love is tested, trust is shattered, and nothing is as it seems. title: Captive Bride: A Dark Mafia Arranged Marriage Romance
description: Read this steamy mafia series by dark romance author M. James. For fans of dark romance authors Nicole Fox, Maggie Cole, and BB Hammel... All I want is my freedom. But the Bratva leader won't take no for an answer… My first husband is dead and buried. I’m left a widowed mafia princess—a dangerous title to hold, especially when one man already has his eye on me. Viktor Andreyev. His own men call him Ussuri. The Bear. Older than me, with a reputation for violence and a cruel exterior to match, he’s no one I would ever choose for a husband. In fact, I’d hoped that I’d never have to marry again at all. But he’s made the price for peace my hand in marriage. And it’s clear that I can’t refuse. I’ve survived marriage to one cruel man already. I’m no fragile princess. I know I can survive this. But the secrets of the Bratva are darker than even I realized, and the more I learn, the more desperate I am to escape. Only one man, and the temptations he poses, stand in the way. He holds my body captive. But he’ll never hold my heart. Captive Bride is book one in the Bridal Trilogy. The trilogy is complete. Reading order Captive Bride, Stolen Bride and Beloved Bride.

title: Wrong Marriage Right Bride II
description: Wrong Marriage Right Bride: Part 2 is a dark Italian mafia arranged marriage romance filled with kidnapping, betrayal, dangerous obsession, pregnancy secrets, revenge, emotional angst, and a possessive mafia don who may lose the only woman who ever truly saved him. She was becoming his weakness. So his enemies turned her into his doubt. Amara Bellini Vassari thought one forbidden night with Luca might change everything. For one fragile moment, the ruthless mafia don remembered the girl who saved him—and not just the daughter of the man he hates. But hope is dangerous in a house built on revenge. When Amara is taken from Luca’s own estate, the fragile trust between them becomes a weapon in the hands of their enemies. A stolen ledger, a jealous almost-bride, a hidden family secret, and a brutal lie threaten to destroy the marriage before it can become real. Luca will burn through the city to find his wife. But saving Amara’s body is not the same as believing her heart. And when a new secret grows between them, love becomes more dangerous than hate. dark mafia romance, Italian mafia romance, mafia arranged marriage romance, wrong bride romance, dark arranged marriage, possessive mafia don, ruthless mafia boss romance, mafia wife romance, kidnapped bride romance, betrayal romance, pregnancy romance, secret pregnancy romance, paternity doubt romance, jealous other woman romance, dark romantic suspense, dangerous obsession romance, revenge marriage romance, forced marriage romance, enemies to lovers, mafia family secrets, hidden ledger, mafia betrayal, emotional angst romance, touch her and die romance, wounded heroine romance, morally gray hero, Italian mafia boss, dark romance series, arranged marriage mafia romance, forbidden desire romance, revenge and betrayal romance

title: Arranged Marriage Mafia
description: What does it feel like to be a Mafia's henchman's daughter?What if you got involved in your father's and Mafia's affairs? What should you do? Could you be able to deal with that? The young and beautiful Carmela has now to deal with it. Carmela loves her dad, Pasquale, more than her own life but this time, Pasquale has made a huge and unforgivable mistake: during a mission, he wrongly killed a client of the ring. Don Vito never forgives and does not easily forget about these kinds of mistakes. As it could predictably happen, Don Vito and his other henchmen break into Carmela and his father's house and kidnap them as he now wants to give them a memorable lesson. Don Vito wants to torture Pasquale to death in front of her daughter's eyes before starting with Carmela. The torture starts but, while torturing Carmela's father in front of her eyes, Don Vito notices that his younger son Salvatore is continuously starring at Carmela. So, it that moment, the boss decides to spare Carmela's life and to take her away while they continue to torture his father Pasquale. Don Vito probably understood that his son Salvatore is in love with Carmela, so he spares her. What is going to happen to Carmela? And what is Salvatore going to do? Will be Carmela able to manage this unpleasant adventure that happened to her? Also, What kind of plans could Don Vito have for the beautiful Carmela and his son Salvatore? You will be able to answer these and other questions only by reading: "Arranged Marriage Mafia A Dark Italian Novel" by Madison Klien. What are you waiting for? Scroll up and add to cart "Arranged Marriage Mafia A Dark Italian Novel" by Madison Klien!

title: Subduing my Queen
description: Elsa The only thing I’ve ever wanted was to marry for love. It’s not so easy for women like me, though. This is the kind of game where we have no control - we are used as tools. And what’s the name of this game? La Cosa Nostra, the Mafia. I was stubborn enough to think I could win in it... My soon-to-be-husband declared his ultimatum and branded me as his Queen. But his words didn't tell me the whole truth. They hid his beasty, merciless nature. Hell cheered the day we married. Because the Devil himself stood before me when our fate was sealed... Eduardo Elsa was gifted to me. And they dared to snatch her from me. They thought that they could touch what was rightfully mine. I made sure their hearts beat no more. I hope she cherishes her new home and life. They aren't going to change anytime soon. She's tough and stubborn, but she will come around. She knows I own her, after all. Mine in a manner only I can understand. Even if she doesn't understand it yet. To conquer her heart, I would do anything. For her, there's nothing I can't do… This is a dark mafia romance. Certain scenes depicted in it could trigger some people. You’ve been warned. Main themes in this story include: arranged marriage, mafia, billionaire, mob and crime fiction, steamy moments, slow burn, dark romance, and many more. HEA guaranteed. No cheating.

title: Chosen to be Mine
description: Alide I was doomed before I could even discern what was going on. My father trusted me to him and now I’m his. His to be wedded, owned, and ‘loved’… He’s been hiding it from me all this time. But one day, the truth came out. Angelo isn’t your ordinary Joe. He’s benevolent and daunting, akin to an angel of death. His voice, our first kiss, and his fake sweetness stole my heart. They were my Achilles’ heel… And his eyes… they always roasted hot through my soul. And yet, nothing can ever make us happen. It just can’t. Angelo She’s sweet. I fell in love with her even before the truth came out. She’s more than the nobody I thought she was. She has a magnetic charm around her. I can’t move away from it. Just one finger. Nothing more than that. But I know better than to let my temptations flourish. She’s petite, young, lighthearted, and too naïve for me. But she’s still intent on fighting everyone after uncovering the truth. I tried to keep it hidden to protect her, but it was too much. It rolled out like a giant snowball. And now Alide hates me more than her father… ‘Chosen to be Mine’ is a dark mafia arranged marriage romance. It’s a standalone, but you should still read all the books in the series for a better experience. No cheating. HEA guaranteed.

title: Damage
description: We’re a match made in hell, Stefan and I. He took me to exact his revenge. I went from being a pawn to my father to being a pawn to Stefan. The only difference is I have a ring the size of a boulder on my finger and a husband I don’t want. And the hardest part is I thought he was different. I thought I was falling in love. I guess my father was right. I’m not a very smart girl. Stefan is a powerful man. He doesn’t play nice, not if you’re his enemy. But I’ve learned one thing about my husband. He takes care of what’s his. And I am his. His enemies have become my enemies, but he’ll never let anyone hurt me. He’s fiercely protective. It’s the predator inside that scares me.

title: Unforgiving Heir III
description: UNFORGIVING HEIR – PART 3 A Dark Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance of Betrayal, a Banished Bride, and a Ruthless Don The war they feared was never the real enemy. As long-buried secrets rise to the surface, old enemies are forced to question everything they believed about loyalty, family, and the price of power. Nico Caruso has spent his life protecting an empire built on blood. Now he faces an impossible choice: cling to a legacy of revenge or risk everything to expose the hidden force manipulating two powerful mafia dynasties from behind the scenes. With trust hanging by a thread and danger closing in from every direction, former rivals must confront an enemy that has spent decades rewriting destinies. Every alliance will be tested. Every vow will be challenged. And every decision could change the future forever. In a world where power is inherited but trust must be earned, love may be the only force strong enough to break a cycle of betrayal. Because some wars are fought with bullets... The deadliest ones are fought with secrets. title: Beg Me
description: Eva I was set to be married to a man I didn’t know… He was mysterious, obscure, and frightening. And I couldn’t even see his face before the wedding itself. But a turn of events shook up everything. A family feud pulled me right to the middle of a turmoil I had nothing to do with. They wanted to kill my husband, and only one man stood in their way. His name was Boris Siciliano, and he was the man of my life… I was going to stand by his side and accept his protection, no matter the cost. That was my promise. Boris They wanted to make Eva marry someone she didn’t even know. But she was mine. She was the love of my life. And there was nothing I could do to impede the wedding… In the meantime, a family dispute reeled her to the middle of something she couldn’t handle. In light of that, no matter what happened, I was going to keep her safe. A new, daunting face appeared… He also wanted her, and he was willing to do even the impossible to make it come true. I was the only one standing in his way. She vowed we were going to marry one day, and I was going to make her happy. That was my promise. ‘Beg Me’ is a dark mafia, arranged marriage romance. Some of the topics and scenes herein can trigger some people.

title: Corrupted Union
description: Keir The governor’s daughter has gotten herself into a mess. If I protect her, her father will owe me, bigtime. But the best way to keep her safe is to marry her. Claim her as one of our own. The catch? She’s got a boyfriend she’s not ready to part with. Good thing an unwilling bride isn’t an issue for a guy like me. Rowan How is it that years of toeing the line could unravel so damn quickly? I’ve done my best to make my parents happy in every way. But when a six-foot tatted Irish gangster showed up at our house, my entire life began to crumble. Now, I’ve woken with a ring tattooed on my finger, and I’m starting to worry there’s no going back. A dark romance with adult themes, Corrupted Union may not be suitable for sensitive audiences. But if you like your men possessive and a steamy read with a guaranteed happily ever after, this steamy forced marriage romance will satisfy your every craving!

title: Break On Through: An Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance
description: Talia My only goal in life is to play the cello in a world-famous orchestra. Unfortunately, education, lessons, and connections don't come cheap. So, when the most notorious Mafia boss in New York City offers me millions to marry one of his men, I have two choices: take the money and follow my dreams, or risk death. I choose to take the money. But if I had known who my husband would be, I would have picked death. Leo might be gorgeous and lethal, but he has never met a woman who refuses to bow. Leo After being pushed out of my country, I lost my woman, my business, and my life. The streets of New York City are dangerous but nothing compared to the wrath growing within me. Joining the Mafia is a natural progression, especially when they help quench my thirst for revenge. When the boss offers me a marriage that will help me reach vengeance, I jump at the chance. I figure she'll be a sweet, quiet girl ... Not the stuck-up musician from the club. She thinks she can always get the last word, but I'm on a warpath that she can't derail. She can either fall in line or fall into pieces.

title: Collided
description: They say keep your enemies close. But what if you fell in love with your worst enemy? Chiara Fiore My father selling my hand in marriage had pissed me off. It was his fault that he'd drained the entirety of the family money gambling. I was paying the price. But then, I finally met Luca. I was really annoyed with how good-looking he was. I wanted to hate him but his strong jaw, and an attitude that screamed "take charge" made me lose my mind. Luca Mendacius Chiara was such a breath of fresh air. She isn't a woman that takes things lying down. She's sharp-witted and smart-mouthed. It's a pity that she's just a pawn in my game.I'd waited seventeen years to get my revenge on the Fiores, and I wasn't going to waste my chance now. Chiara and Luca will have to navigate a rough road to become closer, and even if their differences don't tear them apart, their enemies might. Read on to see how the sparks fly when these two heated personalities collide! Collided is the third book in the Mafia Sinners Series and can be read as a standalone an Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance.

title: Beauty and the Beast Part 3: A Dark Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance
description: FINALE OF TRILOGY Beauty and the Beast. Everyone knows how that fairytale goes, right? How an egotistical motherfucker gets trapped into a spell by a wicked witch, because he looked down upon her, judging her by how she looked before even knowing her. Then having to break that spell, by having a woman fall in love with him in his monster form. Except, I’m no fairytale prince. We all know that all the happily ever after’s from the movies are bullshit. Happily ever after’s don’t exist. Especially for a motherfucker like me. A man who’s done so much wrong, seen things he shouldn’t have seen. Watched men and women get tortured, murdered, be ripped away from their goddamn families. My name is Luca Costello. I grew up in the toughest streets of South Manchester, you know, the area stretching from Hulme to Moss Side up until Longsight. I know there’s that fucking cliché that everybody spits out from around here. “I didn’t choose this life, this life chose me.” “Kill or be killed, eat or be eaten.” Except, I didn’t choose this life. Growing up, I was forced into this way of living. Postcode wars, Turf wars, competing for territory, gunning down any bastard who got in the way of business… It was all I knew. And it was all I was ever going to know. You can’t just leave the streets behind. Once you’re in, there’s no way out. Your past follows you wherever you fucking go. You don’t know how many enemies you’ve made. You don’t know whether the person staring at you from across the street is a stranger, or someone connected to somebody that you’ve crossed in the past. I wanted better for myself. Heck, I needed better. And I knew from the minute I met Zara Amelle, my life was going to turn upside down. She was sexy, bold, confident. A woman who knew what she fucking wanted. Too innocent for my world. But that didn’t stop me. I should have left her alone. I should have left her to live her life. Live her life without me. But she was like a fucking drug. Once I got one taste of her, I kept going back for more. Even if it killed us. They say if you keep dancing with the devil you’ll get burned. I’d been destined for hell my whole damn life. Living a life of sin, hurting so many people who didn’t deserve to be hurt. Except she was the opposite of me. She was like an angel. Who was going to save her from me? This is my story. She was the Beauty… And I was the Beast.

title: Twisted Vows
description: Traded like a poker chip by my own brother. One minute I'm living it up in LA, the next I'm shipped across the country and married to Silvo De Luca-the most dangerous and infuriatingly handsome mafia boss in Philadelphia. Okay, so maybe I slept with him before I knew who he was. And maybe the sex was mind-blowing. But that doesn't mean I'm thrilled about being forced into this marriage. Silvo is arrogant, possessive, with a jealous streak as wide as the Mississippi. He's also irresistibly sexy with those piercing blue eyes and tattoos that make me weak in the knees. When he touches me, I forget every reason to hate him. But this isn't a fairy tale. It's a game of power between crime families, and I refuse to be just a pawn. If Silvo thinks I'll be a docile mafia wife arranging flowers, he's in for a rude awakening. I might be trapped in this marriage, but I'm nobody's doormat. With heated arguments that turn into steamy nights, dangerous family rivals, and secrets that could get us both killed, our twisted vows are becoming something neither of us expected. They say keep your friends close and your enemies closer. But what happens when you can't tell if your husband is one or the other? Twisted Vows is a dark arranged marriage mafia romance and the first book in the Beautiful Gods Series. This dark mafia romance explores themes that may be disturbing to some readers. However, there is no cliffhanger, and the happily-ever-after ending means this book can be read as a standalone.

title: Unforgiving Heir I
description: UNFORGIVING HEIR (Part 1) A Dark Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance of Betrayal, a Banished Bride, and a Ruthless Don She was born into the wrong family. He was raised to trust no one. When an arranged marriage is forced upon Lucia Bellandi to end a deadly mafia war, she expects nothing more than a lifetime of sacrifice. Married to Nico Caruso—the ruthless Don known as the Devil of Milan—she becomes a pawn in a dangerous game where loyalty is bought, betrayal is inevitable, and every smile hides a secret. But behind Nico's cold reputation lies a man carrying scars deeper than anyone can see. As enemies close in from the shadows, Lucia begins to uncover cracks in the empire she's been forced to join. Missing money. Hidden agendas. Dangerous lies. And a conspiracy that reaches far beyond the feud between two powerful families. The closer she gets to the truth... The harder it becomes to decide who she can trust. And when trust begins to grow between husband and wife, someone is determined to destroy it before love has a chance to survive. In a world where every vow comes with a price and every secret can start a war, Lucia and Nico must decide whether to remain prisoners of the past—or risk everything for a future neither of them ever believed possible. Because sometimes... The greatest danger isn't falling in love. It's discovering who has been pulling the strings all along. title: Challenging Destiny
description: “Even if it means I’ll never be the man you give yourself to, I’ll always do anything to protect you.” Natalie He was half shadow, every muscle on his torso flowing from light to dark. A living work of art, everything about him tempting me day and night. Every move gave away his strength, locking me to his destiny… One day, dad handed my life over to him. I now belonged to his desires, and he had no mercy for women who didn’t obey him. Marat was nefarious, immoral, and vicious. But despite those things, I fell in love… Because I needed him as much as he needed me. Even if he didn’t want to admit it initially. It was alright, though. I knew he would soon… Marat She stole my heart the moment my eyes landed on her. Her angelic face was devoid of imperfections. She was so small, and yet, my knees weakened whenever she spoke. Her father trusted her with me. And I swore on my life that she would be happy. Nothing and no one could ever hurt her. It was my promise. When she said yes, the ring glistened enchantingly on her finger… She was ready for our new life together. A life outside of her comfort zone, where she didn’t even speak the language… But that was okay. She had more than enough time to learn… ‘Challenging Destiny’ is a dark mafia, arranged marriage romance. A grumpy, sometimes cocky mafioso and his feisty, strong-willed wife – can love happen between these two? Find that out in this standalone novel. No cheating. HEA guaranteed.

title: Scored
description: It all comes down to this—the conclusion of The Coopers. With the postseason on the line and the dream of a championship within reach, tragedy strikes the Lexington Coopers once again. As Reid Hubbard's daughter, I've spent my life protecting my family's football dynasty. Pressure comes with the name. Expectations come with every game. What I never expected was Griffin Graham. Fourteen years after he shattered my heart, the veteran quarterback is back in my life—and somehow, back in my heart. Now the man I swore I'd never trust again is the one beside me when I fall asleep and the first face I see each morning. But love doesn't make winning easier. The season has come down to this. Every play. Every decision. Every game. My father always wanted a Super Bowl victory. Now, with everything we've fought for hanging in the balance and Fin facing his greatest challenge yet, the future of the Coopers—and our second chance at forever—may depend on the final score. Have you been Aleatha'd? From New York Times bestselling author Aleatha Romig comes a steamy, addictive football romance packed with family legacy, second chances, heartbreak, and jaw-dropping twists. SCORED is Book 4, the dramatic conclusion to the Coopers series. This series must be read in order: INTERCEPTED → RUSHED → SACKED → SCORED.

title: The Devil I Don't Know: An Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance
description: Jacob My father is dying, and I’ve been called back to Brooklyn to take my place as the head of the Italian syndicate. After a seven year absence, my first test of loyalty is to marry the granddaughter of the Irish mob’s leader. I may not want a wife, but I’ll kill anyone who tries to harm her. I only hope she doesn’t expect love in our marriage. I can’t—won’t—love her. Not ever. I don’t have it in me. Brenna My life has always been about duty. When my grandfather signs a marriage contract, I become a pawn in an alliance between the Irish and the Italians. Once again, I’m bound by duty. I’ve always been invisible—the person who fades into the background—except soon my new husband begins to see me. He’s a Brooklyn king, but will our enemies destroy my chance to become his queen? title: Throne of Vengeance
description: When vengeance strikes... You don't know me, but I know you. I'm the shadow that creeps behind you without notice. The moment you see me, you're dead. An assassin. A killer. A nobody. Until I became somebody. I'll make everyone who reduced me to a shadow pay. To do that, I'm willing to risk everything. Everything except for my reluctant wife. Rai Sokolov can show me her worst, but this will only end when death does us part. The road to the throne is paved with loss, betrayal, and blood baths. To win, we go all in. Our lives included. This book is the conclusion of a duet and is not standalone.

title: CODE OF SILENCE (BOOK 1) : A Dark Mafia Arranged Marriage Romance of Ex-Lovers and Second Chances
description: BOOK 1 CODE OF SILENCE A Dark Mafia Arranged Marriage Romance of Ex-Lovers and Second Chances Gabrielle S. Fox Four years ago, Damian Valenti broke Isabella Romano’s heart and disappeared. Now he’s back—and the ruthless Mafia boss has come with a marriage proposal she never saw coming. Isabella has spent years building a life far away from the blood, power, and secrets of her family’s criminal world. But when the Romano empire begins to collapse under mysterious debts, stolen fortunes, murdered allies, and enemies closing in, she has no choice but to face the one man she swore she would never love again. Damian claims their marriage is necessary to protect her family. Isabella doesn’t believe him. Not when he’s the same man who once walked away without a goodbye. Living under the same roof should make hatred easier. Instead, old memories return. So does the attraction neither of them managed to bury. But Damian is keeping one devastating secret. Someone wanted Isabella dead four years ago—and the danger has returned with a vengeance. Now Isabella must decide whether the man who shattered her heart is actually the only person standing between her and the grave. Because in the Mafia, silence protects secrets. And some secrets can destroy a second chance before it even begins. Perfect for readers who love dark Mafia romance, arranged marriage romance, ex-lovers, second chance love, ruthless Mafia bosses, forced proximity, possessive heroes, family secrets, betrayal, suspense, and dangerous forbidden attraction.

title: Queen of the Night
description: When I waged war to become the Pakhan of the Bratva in order to protect my daughter, I didn't expect to be ambushed by an arranged marriage. The Irish wanted to cement our alliance, as if the sacrifices I've made for them weren't enough. Now they expected me to engage in their barbaric customs; blood oaths, hand fasts and other ridiculous rituals. They presented me with this fiery-haired, waifish, scared little thing with a unpronounceable name. I was halfway ready to back out when she stabbed me right in the middle of dinner. Her unexpected show of back bone told me that there was more to my little fiancée than meets the eye. I'd relish unraveling her, secret by secret. In the end, there was only one question I had for our wedding day: Did she want the heads of her enemies on a platter? Or would she rather plunge the knife into them herself? My little witch came to me broken and scared, but with me as her weapon she became the fire to burn them. Queen of the Night is the start of a duology and will conclude with King of the Dawn.

title: Wrong Marriage Right Groom I
description: She found a frightened little girl hiding behind a boiler. She never imagined the child belonged to Milan’s most dangerous man. Elena Moretti is a fiercely independent Deaf book conservator who has spent years escaping her father’s criminal legacy. When she discovers six-year-old Sofia barefoot, wounded, and terrified of the police, Elena refuses to hand her over to anyone she cannot trust. For twelve dangerous days, Elena protects the child, teaches her that silence can still have a voice, and becomes the one person Sofia feels safe calling Mama. Then Elena learns the truth. Sofia is the missing daughter of Dante Vitale—a ruthless billionaire, grieving widower, and secret ruler of a powerful mafia empire. Dante has torn Europe apart searching for his daughter. But when Sofia finally returns, she refuses to let Elena go. Worse, Dante discovers that Elena is the daughter of the man he blames for his wife’s death. Caught between his daughter’s fragile recovery and his hunger for revenge, Dante offers Elena a brutal bargain: Marry him, live under his protection, and remain in Sofia’s life—or lose everything she loves. Elena knows the ring is another kind of prison. Dante believes she is only a weapon against his enemy. But inside his cold lakeside fortress, hatred begins turning into hunger, secrets refuse to stay buried, and a marriage built on vengeance becomes dangerously difficult to control. Because the greatest threat to Dante Vitale’s empire may not be his enemies. It may be the silent bride teaching his heart how to feel again. title: The Mafia Marriage Contract
description: Marrying the enemy was never part of my plan. I came to America to escape the shackles of my family's criminal empire. To carve my own path, far away from the blood-soaked legacy of the O'Callaghan name. But when my father makes a deal with the devil himself-Kingston Viacava-I'm the pawn sacrificed to cement an alliance. Kingston is everything I despise. Arrogant. Ruthless. A man born and bred to rule the underworld. He wears power like a second skin, commanding loyalty with a single look. And now, with this ring on my finger, he thinks he owns me. But he'll learn soon enough-I bow to no man. Our wedding is nothing but a spectacle, a performance to unite our warring families against an even deadlier enemy. But behind closed doors, it's a battleground of sharp tongues, venomous threats, and a dangerous attraction I can't fight. He's my captor, my tormentor. The man who promises to break me. But when a bullet rips through the night and the enemy strikes, I realize something far more terrifying... Kingston may be the only man who can keep me alive. A forced marriage. A deadly rivalry. A passion that burns as hot as their hate. The Mafia Marriage Contract is a dark, steamy enemies-to-lovers mafia romance with an alpha anti-hero, a fierce heroine, and enough heat to set your Kindle on fire. No cheating, no cliffhangers-just a deliciously sinful HEA. Author Note: This book contains mature content not suitable for readers under eighteen. Please see book for full list of trigger warnings.

title: Rising Waters
description: A dark psychological thriller packed with small-town secrets, buried trauma, and shocking twists. She escaped her past—and the man she never forgot. Now both are pulling her back into a deadly game she may not survive. Jillian Thorne built her career making the unreal feel real. On Hollywood soundstages, she stages murder, kidnapping, and violent crime with chilling authenticity—turning fiction into gripping entertainment. But nothing she’s created compares to the truth waiting in Blue Gil. Nearly six years after escaping her small hometown, Jillian is drawn back by the suspicious death of the town’s beloved high school football coach. What first appears to be a tragic loss quickly unravels into something far more sinister—a dark mystery no one is willing to confront. Because in Blue Gil, secrets aren’t just buried… they’re protected. As disturbing clues surface and a brutal tragedy strikes dangerously close to home, Jillian finds herself trapped inside a real-life psychological thriller. The instincts that made her successful in Hollywood may be the key to solving the crime—or the very thing clouding her judgment. Everyone in this small town is hiding something. Including Jillian. To uncover the truth, she must break through an unspoken code of silence, deception, and loyalty—and face the past she thought she left behind. Because some secrets refuse to stay buried. And in this twisted game of suspense, trusting the wrong person could be deadly. Have you been Aleatha’d? This is a complete 78K stand-alone psychological thriller with a STEM FMC who needs to learn secrets before it’s too late. The only connection to Aleatha’s FEAR OF FLAMES is that our favorite podcasters from Crime Daily Podcast are back, showing the readers another perspective. *You do not need to read Crime Daily Podcast book one, FEAR OF FLAMES before RISING WATERS.

title: Arranged
description: When it came to Mia Carfano, all it took was a single look and I was done. Gone. Obsessed. And no matter what I had to do, she was going to be mine... I was going to start living my life for myself for once, but he had other plans. Santino Antonucci. My family needs to make a deal with his, and as the head of the Antonucci family, the only way Santino will agree to help is if I marry him. I've never met him. I don't even know what he looks like. All I know is that he's fourteen years older than me, he was supposed to marry my cousin last year, and after he saw me at another cousin's wedding a few months ago, he decided he had to have me. If he thinks I'm flattered by that, I'm not. I'm only marrying Santino because my family needs this deal with him to go through, and just because I'm agreeing to the marriage, it doesn't mean I'm agreeing to give him any part of me. Santino Antonucci is an arrogant a**hole who thinks he can have me simply because he wants me, but he'll soon learn I'm not someone he can easily manipulate. But then a mistaken encounter leaves us both wanting more, and while he says he won't touch me again until I beg him to, from the moment we say 'I do', he's the one that's doing all the begging. And I have to admit, I like seeing him on his knees. I went into this arrangement with a plan. With rules. But Santino wasn't a man I could've prepared for. I thought when he slid that ring on my finger it'd be a prison sentence and I'd spend the next few years finding every which way to escape. But with each day that passes, I find myself losing my will to break free from the life we're creating together. Of course, so long as the enemy lurking in the shadows doesn't rip my new life from me before I have the chance to finally be happy.

title: Brutal Power
description: An exciting and steamy standalone arranged marriage mafia romance from bestselling author B. B. Hamel. I shouldn't have stalked my future husband. When he catches me staring at him in the gym- He drags me into the sauna. And I'm in big trouble. When my brother the Don orders me to marry Brody Quinn, I agree to sacrifice my happiness for the Famiglia. Brody is the head of a powerful Irish crime family with deep connections to the police department. He's like a storm cloud on a beautiful day: huge, dark, gorgeous, and a total nightmare. This marriage is only a business deal, and I'm not interested in the way he looks at me every time I walk into a room. I want to end a brutal war my family's been waging for years now, and Brody wants to push through a building project despite heavy political opposition. Except Brody's a grumpy beast and he won't settle for less than all of me. He demands a wife in more than just name: live in his house, sleep in his bed, give him as many children as he wants. Which is how I end up faced with an impossible choice: Fall into his bed and sacrifice everything for what he desires, or stand up and fight for what matters.

title: Arranged Addiction
description: My world just got turned upside down. An arranged marriage to a ruthless mafia kingpin was never in my plans especially to Deacon D’Angelo, the cold, calculating leader of the D’Angelo family. But here I am, bound by a union designed for power, not love. Deacon is everything I never wanted: a monster in a tailored suit. He's dangerous, haunted, and determined to make me his... even if I have to be his prisoner to do it. From the moment we meet, the tension between us is unbearable. I’m a mercenary with my own agenda, but now I’m forced to play by his rules. He says it’s all about loyalty. But the truth is, the D’Angelo empire isn’t the only thing at stake here our lives are too. The night we share a dangerous kiss, everything changes. He claims me. He dominates me. And then, just as I start to break through his cold exterior, I realize he’s hiding secrets. Deep, dark secrets that tie us both to a past neither of us can escape. Deacon promises he’ll protect me but will I ever be safe in his arms? Or will his obsession destroy us both? A deadly enemy lurks in the shadows, and the deeper I dig, the more I realize that everything I thought I knew about love, loyalty, and family has been a lie. Arranged Addiction is a full-length standalone dark mafia romance filled with heat, twists, and betrayal. No cliffhanger, and a happily-ever-after is guaranteed. For fans of dark romance, age-gap dynamics, mafia politics, arranged marriages, and toxic, obsessive love. Enjoy!

title: Defending Love
description: He’d die to protect her. He just can’t love her. I’m Elijah Rhodes—top-tier agent for Guardian Security. We protect the world’s elite: heads of state, royalty, billionaires, celebrities. The untouchable. I didn’t come from that world. I came from Special Ops, from impossible missions and impossible choices. The kind that harden a man until there’s nothing left worth saving. That’s why I have rules: No long-term assignments. No repeat clients. No attachments. Protect. Leave. Forget. It’s the only way I survive. Until Dr. Danielle Sinclair. Brilliant. Beautiful. Completely off-limits. I protected her once—and then I walked away before she could see just how dangerous I really am. Now, one year later, Dani’s life is on the line. And every instinct I have demands I break every rule I’ve ever lived by to keep her safe. Some lines shouldn’t be crossed. Some rules were made to be broken. I’ll protect Dani with my life. But I can’t give her a heart I no longer have. Have you been Aleatha’d? DEFENDING LOVE is a steamy standalone romantic suspense featuring an elite bodyguard hero, second chances, forced proximity, danger, obsession, and all the feels—set in the world of the Sinclair Duet.

title: Fear of Flames
description: A twisty small-town psychological thriller with romantic suspense, buried family secrets, and shocking twists. She writes thrillers for a living. Now she’s trapped inside one. Michelle Holdcraft lives a quiet life in small-town Indiana. But under the pen name D. Valentine, she’s a bestselling thriller author known for writing dark secrets, murder, and shocking twists. Then one trip changes everything. When Michelle travels to Iron Falls, Massachusetts to visit her estranged father, she wakes to a gunshot, a house engulfed in flames, and her father dead on the floor. Barefoot and alone, she escapes into the snowy woods—becoming the only witness to a murder someone will kill to keep hidden. Especially the sheriff. Desperate and out of options, Michelle accepts help from a mysterious stranger named Fletch, a dangerously attractive man who knows far too much about her life, her family, and the secrets surrounding her mother’s death. Then she sees the tattoo on his back. The same tattoo her father had. Now Michelle is trapped in a deadly web of lies, corruption, and buried secrets where no one can be trusted—and falling for the wrong man could cost her everything. Because in Iron Falls, some secrets were never meant to survive. Have you been Aleatha’d?

title: Falling for Sin Part 9 (Finale): A Dark Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance
description: When I saw her from across the bar with her pretty little face, her big brown eyes, her long black hair and her beautiful, fuck-me body, I just knew that I would never be able to shake her from my damn mind. She turned my life upside down from the day I fucking laid eyes on her. But then, the situation changed. She saw something she shouldn’t have seen. Found out who I really was. The truth behind my rugged exterior. But you know the rules of the Corsican Mafia. No witnesses… So I had to take her in. I had to make her my hostage. And I had to make her my wife… Whether she liked it or not.

title: Divorcing the Mafia Don
description: On our wedding anniversary, a new post popped up on my Instagram. It was from my mafia husband, he was with his first love and her child, setting off fireworks. The child reached up and called my husband Daddy. Enzo held them both like they were the family he'd chosen. I froze. Then, a divorce agreement was quickly drafted. What Enzo didn't know was that I took my pain, my unborn child, and the last piece of my pride, and I disappeared. Later, he panicked and searched for me all over the world, but he could never find me again.

title: RUSHED
description: From the bestselling author of Infidelity and Sin comes an addictive football romance series filled with power plays, forbidden passion, and jaw-dropping twists. He was her past. Now he might cost her the future. I was born into a football dynasty built on power, money, and secrets. Now those secrets are unraveling. The truth about my family threatens everything from the franchise to the locker room. Allies I trusted have their own agendas. And in the NFL’s ruthless good ol’ boys club, there’s no mercy for a woman who dares to challenge the league’s power structure. This isn’t just football. It's an empire. It's a legacy. It’s war. With the franchise and my future on the line, there’s only one man I might be able to trust. Fin—Griffin Graham. Elite NFL quarterback. The new face of the team. My past. My weakness. My second chance. Our chemistry still burns hotter than game-day lights. But in a professional football world ruled by contracts, media scrutiny, and billion-dollar reputations, falling for the star quarterback again could destroy everything we’re fighting to protect. With more than our season on the line, I’m forced to choose a side. Will it be the right choice? Have you been Aleatha’d? Rushed is book two of The Coopers, a second-chance sports romance wrapped in betrayal, dynasty drama, and high-stakes romantic suspense set in the seductive, cutthroat world of professional football. RUSHED ends on a cliffhanger—an unforgettable Aleatha blindside. The Coopers is a four-book football romance saga following one explosive couple, beginning with INTERCEPTED, which must be read prior to RUSHED. Perfect for fans of the ruthless tension of Succession and the dark, aching obsession of Wuthering Heights.

title: Not his Baby
description: The pakhan of the Bratva mafia, Daniel, is a force to be reckoned with. With his chiseled body, tattoos, and smoldering eyes, he exudes danger and power. Despite his ruthless reputation, my heart aches for him. The press of his lips on mine, the graze of his stubbly chin, and the touch of his callous hands make me weak in the knees. I know I should keep my distance, but every fiber of my being longs to be closer to him. But falling for dangerous men is a pattern I can't afford to repeat. My heart has led me astray before, and I can't let it happen again. Nevertheless, fate has other plans. I'm pregnant with Daniel's child, and the thought of his reaction sends shivers down my spine. If he finds out, I'm sure he'll stop at nothing to make me his. I'm not ready to be a part of his dangerous world, but I can't ignore the growing life inside me. I have to keep my pregnancy a secret from Daniel, but the truth is getting harder to conceal. Every day is a battle to keep the lie alive, but I know that I can't hide my growing bump forever. I'm torn between my love for Daniel and my fear of what he'll do when he finds out. Will he protect our unborn child, or will he use it as a pawn in his dangerous game?

title: Not My Daughter
description: I never intend for it to happen. It's just supposed to be a one-night stand, a temporary escape from my mundane life. But as soon as I lay eyes on him, I know that one night will never be enough. He's a Russian god, with a towering presence and a body so perfect it could make angels weep. His piercing green eyes bore into my soul, and I'm powerless to resist. I know the risks of falling for him, but my body craves his touch, and my heart yearns for his love. The problem is, I'm already in a committed relationship with his older brother. I know I'm playing with fire, but I can't help myself. The passion we share is too intense, too explosive, too romantic. I know it's wrong, but my love for him grows stronger with each passing day. The guilt weighs heavily on me, but I can't bring myself to end it. I'm addicted to him, and I can't let him go. And then the unexpected happens. I find out I'm pregnant with his child. The news turns my world upside down. The guilt and shame consume me, and I don't know what to do. Should I tell him the truth and risk losing everything? Should I leave my current partner and start a new life with the man I truly love? I'm torn between what's right and what my heart desires. But one thing is for certain; I can't keep this secret forever. The consequences of my actions will eventually catch up to me, and I'm running out of time.

title: Beloved Bride: A Dark Mafia Arranged Marriage Romance
description: Read this steamy mafia series by dark romance author M. James. For fans of dark romance authors Nicole Fox, Maggie Cole, and BB Hammel... Is almost losing everything enough to change a man? My husband is about to lose everything he’s worked so hard to keep. His empire. His daughter. Me. I can’t love a man who does the things that Viktor does. I can’t belong to him, not in the way I want to. It doesn’t matter what he’s awakened in me, or how much I crave him. How much my heart wants him. Or at least, that’s what I tell myself. But the danger Viktor poses to my heart isn’t all we’re facing. Alexei is coming. For me, for Sofia, for Ana, to wipe out the men of the three families and take it all for himself. If he takes me, I know that Viktor won’t rest until he saves me. But what I want more than anything is for Viktor to save himself. I want him to become the man that I know he can be—so that I can become everything I long to be for him. His lover. His wife. His beloved bride. Beloved Bride is the final book in The Bridal Trilogy. The series is complete. The reading order is as follows: Captive Bride, Stolen Bride, Beloved Bride. Beloved Bride contains several scenes that readers may find difficult. Readers with sensitivity to some material should proceed with caution.

title: Collateral Damage
description: ﻿This duet contains both books of the Collateral Damage Duet! Gabriela Stefan Sabbioni showed up uninvited in my bedroom on my birthday. He stood in the shadows smelling of whiskey and death and wrapped a broken, blood-crusted necklace around my neck. I thought he’d strangle me with it. That night, he left a message for my father. He said he’d be back to take something precious. I never delivered that message, though. I wonder if things would be different if I had because now, two years later, he’s back. And he’s not hiding in any shadows. He’s come to make good on his promise. He’s back to take that something precious. Me. Stefan Marchese is the manipulator of my family’s tragedy. I won’t just bring him to his knees. I’ll bury him for what he did. Taking his daughter is only the beginning. I’ll do it knowing I’m starting a war. I’ll do it knowing my enemies will become his allies. They’ll stop at nothing to destroy me and he’ll stop at nothing to get her back. I’ve never shied away from war, though. I’m not one to play nice and I don’t share my toys. I’ll demolish you if you touch what’s mine. And she is most definitely mine.

title: Bred By The Mafia Boss In Arranged Marriage
description: The alliance contract demands I take Daphne as my wife and fill her with my child before the deadline, or the territories fall. In the private office above the club, she stands beside my desk with her hand extended to the signature line, red hair striking in the dim light, and the air grows heavier with each breath we share. Her outward compliance hides the same fear of abandonment that drives my need to possess her completely. The knife scar on my arm reminds me what it costs to lose control. The territory map spread across the desk watches as I step closer, knowing one signature will demand I breed her until she carries my heir and binds us both in the permanence I have always craved.

title: Forced to Wed the Mafia Heir
description: In the shadowy underbelly of Chicago, where loyalty is currency and power is everything, 18-year-old Kylie Santos finds herself at the center of a dangerous game she never asked to play. What happens when duty collides with desire? When the price of family loyalty is your own heart? Born into the notorious Santos crime family, Kylie has always known her life would be different. But nothing could have prepared her for the bombshell her father drops one fateful evening. As rival gangs close in, threatening to destroy everything the Santos family has built over generations, Kylie learns that she is to be the linchpin in a desperate plan for survival. "You will marry his oldest son, Lysander," her father declares, his voice as cold and unyielding as steel. In an instant, Kylie's world shatters. She's to be wed to Lysander Vincenzo, heir to the New York Familia—their longtime enemies turned reluctant allies. But can decades of bloodshed and mistrust truly be erased by a single union? Suddenly, Kylie is thrust into a world of high-stakes politics and deadly power plays. Every move she makes could tip the delicate balance between peace and all-out war. As she navigates this treacherous new reality, Kylie must grapple with her own desires and ambitions. Can she sacrifice her dreams for the greater good of her family? Or will she find a way to forge her own path amidst the chaos? But Lysander Vincenzo is no mere pawn in this game of chess. Rumored to be as ruthless as he is handsome, he harbors his own secrets and ambitions. As Kylie and Lysander circle each other warily, an unexpected spark ignites between them. Could their arranged union blossom into something real? Or will the weight of family expectations and old grudges snuff out any chance at true love? Book 1 of the series

title: Bride by Debt I (Book II)
description: BRIDE BY DEBT — PART 1 BOOK II She was given to a ruthless Mafia Don to settle a debt. She never expected their stolen vows to become the most dangerous choice of her life. Aria De Luca never chose the marriage that changed everything. Her family’s debts left her with one impossible price to pay: becoming the wife of powerful Mafia Don Nikolai De Luca. Their vows may have been written into a contract, but surviving a life inside his dangerous world demands more than obedience. Nikolai is feared, powerful, and used to getting what he wants. Aria is the woman who refuses to disappear beneath his shadow. As their cold arrangement begins to blur into something neither expected, Aria discovers that the debt that destroyed her family may not have been an accident. Someone wanted the Bellandis desperate—and the truth may be connected to something far more valuable than money. Then a mysterious painting belonging to Aria’s mother arrives. Hidden beneath its restoration is a warning. And behind that warning is a secret involving seven paintings, buried records, powerful enemies, and an international criminal network. But the greatest shock is still waiting. A photograph appears to show Aria’s mother, Lucia Bellandi, alive years after the world believed she was dead. Now Aria must question everything she thought she knew about her family, her marriage, and the man standing beside her. Because their marriage may have started with debt. But what comes next could cost them everything. Their vows were forced. Their attraction is real. And the secret waiting behind the seventh painting could change their entire world.
