title: The Devil I Don't Know: an Arranged Marriage Mafia Romance
description: Jacob My father is dying, and I've been called back to Brooklyn to take my place as the head of the Italian syndicate. After a seven year absence, my first test of loyalty is to marry the granddaughter of the Irish mob's leader. I may not want a wife, but I'll kill anyone who tries to harm her.I only hope she doesn't expect love in our marriage. I can't--won't--love her. Not ever. I don't have it in me.BrennaMy life has always been about duty. Then, my grandfather signs a marriage contract, and I become a pawn in an alliance between the Irish and the Italians. Once again I'm bound by duty.I've always been invisible--the person who fades into the background--except soon my new husband begins to see me. He's a Brooklyn king, but will our enemies destroy my chance to become his queen?

title: Hollow Vows
description: For Theodora Vasconcelos, quiet elegance was a fragile shield. Until her family’s ancient debts came due, demanding an unthinkable price: her hand in marriage to Cassius Thorne, the city’s most formidable and ruthless mafia Don. Stolen from her life of subdued grace, Theo is thrust into an opulent, gilded cage, bound by hollow vows to a man whose chilling presence promises ownership, not love. Cassius Thorne takes what he wants, and now, he claims Theo as his own. He might see her as property, a pawn in his dangerous game of power and vengeance, but Theo refuses to be broken. With every defiant glance, every challenging word, she probes for cracks in his impenetrable facade, determined to find a way out of her gilded prison. But as she navigates the treacherous underworld he commands, Theo uncovers a dark legacy, a truth connecting their families far deeper than mere debt. With dangerous rivals circling and secrets threatening to unravel them both, the line between hatred and a terrifying, undeniable desire begins to blur. Can a marriage forged in blood and lies ever become real, or will their fragile bond be consumed by the shadows they inhabit?

title: Sinister Vows
description: I was sold to the Don of the Italian mafia when I was twelve years old. Now, at twenty, I've been summoned to Nicolas Capasso's home, a man I've never even met, for my wedding day. No wiser of what it means to be a wife to a man like him. Let alone what goes on between a husband and wife in the dark. Nonetheless, I was assured it was all part of the plan. Step one, marry the Don. Got it. Step two, provide him with as many children as he requires. Gross. Step three, live silently and dutifully as the wife to the most powerful man in history. Oh, come on. The only thing standing in the way of completing such a simple plan, you ask. The blessing ceremony on the eve of my wedding. The most outdated form of torture imaginable on a pure bride like me, and something my family had been doing for centuries. Yet, when I found myself dressed in white, laid atop a ceremonial bedspread, and offered up to the deviant priest as a sacrifice, the man that walked into the room wasn't at all what I expected. Don't even get me started on what he did to my body during the ceremony, or what carnal things he made me feel while he did it. My future marriage was supposed to be blessed by the ceremony, paving the way to a peaceful union between our families. But if that was the case, why was it the man from the night before that consumed my every thought as I walked down the aisle the next day?

title: By Order of the Capo
description: My father was blown up in the restaurant he ate at every Tuesday. I was first on scene. I was the one who identified him. I've been the family numbers girl since I was fourteen — the one who found the traitor three years ago, the one nobody thanks. Now the council has handed me to Marco Rinaldi like a file. Wife, ward, whatever they're calling...

title: Irish Rogue
description: Anya Five years ago I was sold. Used. Abused. Now, I'm broken. My loving family thinks a husband will fix me. I have no desire to get married, but I'll give them what they want. Except it will be on my terms. And I know just the person to ask. Paddy Getting married is at the top of the list of things I swore I'd never do. So there's no way I'll agree to Anya's ridiculous proposition. Yet, somehow, I find myself saying yes. She says we both can live our lives without interference from the other. It seems like the perfect plan. Until it isn't. *Author's note: Please visit my website for CW

title: Bride by Debt II (Book II)
description: BRIDE BY DEBT — PART 2 BOOK II The marriage began with a debt. Now the truth may cost them everything. Aria thought becoming Nikolai De Luca’s wife was the price she had to pay for her family’s mistakes. But somewhere between the danger, the secrets, and the man she was never supposed to love, their forced marriage became something neither of them expected. Now, an old letter threatens to change everything. A buried family secret is resurfacing. A missing piece of evidence has been found. Someone is watching their every move. And the truth surrounding Aria’s mother, the De Luca family, and a collection of mysterious paintings may be far more dangerous than either of them imagined. Nikolai has built his world on power, loyalty, and control. But protecting Aria means learning that loving her is not the same as controlling her. As husband and wife, they must uncover the truth before their enemies do. Because someone has been waiting years for these secrets to surface. And someone is willing to kill to keep them buried. title: Ruthless King
description: As the coveted Russian mafia princess, I have lived my entire life in my own golden prison. I have felt pain and cruelty at my own father's hand. Now I will marry the Italian Mafia's Capo, Alessio to unite our two families. From the very first night he showed me brutality I should be used to by now. If he thinks I will break so easily, he's mistaken. I have lived among monsters my entire life. I will survive.

title: Subduing My Queen
description: "Nobody has ever looked at me the way he's looking at me at this moment. Like I'm his possession. Like if anyone else were to touch me, he'd break both their legs and an arm for good measure." - A. ZAVARELLI, CROW Elsa The only thing I've ever wanted was to marry for love. Women like me can't have that indulgence, though. This is the kind of game where we have no control - we are used as tools. And what is the name of the game? La Cosa Nostra, the Mafia. I was stubborn enough to think I could win it... My soon-to-be-husband stated his ultimatum and called me his Queen. But his words didn't tell me the whole truth. They hid his beast, merciless nature. Hell cheered the day we married. Because the Devil himself stood before me when our fate was sealed... Eduardo Elsa was gifted to me. And they dared to snatch her from me. Thought they could touch what was rightfully mine. I made sure their hearts beat no more. I hope she cherishes her new home and life. They aren't going to change anytime soon. She's tough, stubborn, but she will come around. She knows I own her, after all. Mine in a manner only I can understand. Even if she doesn't comprehend it yet. To conquer her heart, I would do anything. For her, there's nothing I can't do... This is a dark mafia romance. Some scenes depicted in it could trigger some people. You've been warned. HEA guaranteed, and there is no cheating.

title: Challenging Destiny
description: "Even if it means I'll never be the man you give yourself to, I'll always do anything to protect you." Natalie He was half shadow, every muscle on his torso flowing from light to dark. A living work of art, and his skin was so tempting to touch. Every move gave away his strength, locking me to his destiny... One day, dad handed my life to him. I belonged to his desires, and he had no mercy for women who didn't obey him. Marat was nefarious, immoral and vicious. But despite those things, I fell in love... Because I needed him as much as he needed me. Even if he didn't want to admit that initially. It was alright, though. I knew he soon would... Marat She stole my heart the moment my eyes landed on her. Her angelic face was devoid of imperfections. She was so small, and yet, my knees weakened whenever she spoke. Her father trusted her with me. And I swore on my life that she would be happy. Nothing and no one could ever harm her. That was my promise. When she said yes, the ring glistened enchantingly on her finger... She was ready for our new life. A life outside of her comfort zone, where she didn't even speak the language... But that was okay. She had more than enough time to settle in... This is a dark mafia romance, and some scenes in it might trigger some people. You've been warned. No cheating. HEA guaranteed.

title: Bruno
description: Forced to marry a paralyzed Don who swear he will never touch her. She refuses to live unwanted in her own marriage. My father's gambling debts bought me a husband and a cage. Bruno Sartori didn't want a wife. He wanted proof he could still lead and Pietro handed him an arranged marriage as a test. I was the transaction. The name on a contract. The woman assigned to the west wing while he stayed in the east and pretended I didn't exist. He didn't speak to me for a week. So I spoke for both of us. I walked toward him when everyone else stepped aside. I knocked on his door when no one else dared. I sat with his family and smiled and held the room together while he sat at the head of the table looking at me like I was a problem he hadn't solved yet. He was wrong about never touching me. He was wrong about a lot of things. But Bruno Sartori built his walls out of two years of grief and pride and rage - and I'm twenty-one years old with nothing left to lose and everything to prove. This isn't the marriage he planned. It's becoming something neither of us can walk away from. *Bruno is a full-length mafia romance novel with no cheating and a guaranteed HEA. Tropes: forced marriage obsessive hero slow burn explicit content dark themes mafia violence happily ever after

title: Pretty Plaything
description: As a mafia princess, I've always known that one day I'd have to marry the man my father chooses. But I never thought that man would be Alessandro Bellini. Ruthless, heartless, and twisted, he's the last person I want to meet, let alone spend the rest of my life with. Alessandro demands my complete obedience and my body to use as he pleases. He wants me to be his plaything in his special dungeon. But even though he's the embodiment of everything I hate, he knows how to play my body and make me feel things I haven't even known existed. As the spark between us ignites, I find myself wanting something I've never wanted before. Will my wish come true? Pretty Plaything is a standalone dark arranged marriage mafia romance with potentially triggering situations and is intended for mature audiences.

title: The Mafia Heir's Obsession
description: He was never supposed to touch her. Now he'll burn the world to keep her. Callahan Murphy is a ruthless Irish mafia boss with blood on his hands and vengeance in his veins. When he strikes a power deal with a New York crime family, marriage to the Don's daughter is just another strategic move-until everything goes to hell. Because the bride he's promised? Vanishes. And her younger sister is offered in her place. Luciana de Rosa is untouched, unwilling, and unprepared for the savage man who now claims her as his own. She thought this arrangement was temporary-a mistake that could be undone once her sister returned. She was wrong. When a violent night in Queens ends with her pinned beneath Callahan, gasping for breath and drowning in pleasure, she realizes her life will never be the same. He's her father's ally, her family's nightmare, and her most dangerous mistake. But Luciana isn't the submissive bride Callahan expected. She fights him at every turn, challenging his authority and igniting a possessive hunger that threatens to consume them both. Every moment of defiance makes him want her more. Every touch makes her crave the very man she should fear. He swore he'd never let her go. But when family secrets unravel and blood debts come due, their arranged marriage becomes a battlefield where love and loyalty collide. In his world, she's not just a woman-she's a weapon, a weakness, a wife. And he'll kill anyone who touches her. But when enemies close in and the past refuses to stay buried, Callahan will have to choose: protect his empire or save the woman who's become his everything. Obsessive. Possessive. Unforgiving. Some marriages are made in heaven. Theirs was forged in blood. A standalone dark mafia romance featuring an Irish alpha hero, forced marriage, enemies-to-lovers tension, and an HEA worth fighting for. Author Note: Due to graphic and explicit content, this book is not suitable for readers under eighteen years of age. A full trigger warning list is included in the book.

title: Auge um Auge - Collateral
description: Gabriela Stefan Sabbioni stand an meinem sechzehnten Geburtstag uneingeladen in meinem Schlafzimmer. Er verbarg sich im Schatten, roch nach Whiskey und Tod und legte mir eine zerbrochene, blutverkrustete Halskette um den Hals. Ich dachte, er würde mich damit erdrosseln. In dieser Nacht hinterließ er eine Nachricht für meinen Vater. Er sagte, er käme zurück, um etwas Wertvolles mitzunehmen. Ich überbrachte diese Nachricht nie. Jetzt, zwei Jahre später, ist er wieder da und ich frage mich, ob die Dinge anders gelaufen wären, wenn ich es meinem Vater gesagt hätte. Denn jetzt versteckt sich Stefan nicht mehr in irgendwelchen Schatten. Er ist gekommen, um sein Versprechen einzulösen. Er ist hier, um etwas Kostbares zu holen. Mich. Stefan Marchese hat die Tragödie rund um meine Familie eingefädelt. Ich werde ihn nicht nur in die Knie zwingen. Ich werde ihn für das, was er getan hat, begraben. Ihm seine Tochter zu nehmen ist nur der Anfang. Ich werde es tun, obwohl ich weiß, dass ich damit einen Krieg beginne. Ich werde es in dem Wissen tun, dass meine Feinde seine Verbündeten werden. Sie werden vor nichts Halt machen, um mich zu zerstören, und er wird vor nichts Halt machen, um Gabriela zurück zu bekommen. Ich habe mich noch nie vor einem Krieg gescheut. Ich bin nicht nett und teile mein Spielzeug nicht. Ich zerstöre dich, wenn du anfasst, was mir gehört. Und sie gehört ganz sicher mir. Auge um Auge - Collateral ist Buch Eins des Collateral Damage Duetts.

title: Corrupted Crown
description: My best friend's sister needs protection and I need a wife. Kyla Costigan. I can't even say her name without my mouth twisting like I've just tasted poison. Because that's exactly what she is - vicious and stubborn enough to battle the devil himself. She also happens to be the sexiest, most gorgeous woman I've ever laid eyes on...and my best friend's little sister. Time has transformed every inch of her into a sultry vixen, but she still has a black heart trapped inside a body I'd die for. Kyla is also the only woman who can to turn me into a power-hungry and ruthless animal, and right now, that's exactly who I have to be if I'm going to save my family. Turns out, we need each other. So the arrangement has been made. She-Devil is about to become a Mrs. My Mrs. That is, if we don't kill each other first. I'm going to need a bigger pitchfork if I have any shot of surviving. CORRUPTED CROWN is the jaw-dropping and explosive first book in the RECKLESS REIGN trilogy by USA Today Bestselling author Kristen Luciani and the first book of Patrick and Kyla's story. It is an Enemies to Lovers, Arranged Marriage, Second Chance Dark Mafia romance that fans of Nicole Fox and Faith Summers are sure to enjoy! This epic family saga ends with a guaranteed HEA in book three, TARNISHED THRONE. Each trilogy in the MAFIA CRIME KINGS series is about one couple and their journey toward HEA. For the best reading experience, it is suggested that you read the trilogies in order, beginning with CORRUPTED CROWN. Publisher's Note: CORRUPTED CROWN contains adult themes, mature content, and graphic violence some readers might find offensive and/or triggering.

title: Sinister Engagement
description: He was given a choice: my sister or me. He chose me. Gaven Belmonte is one of the most dangerous hitmen in the world, and I'm the daughter of one of the richest mafia families in the country. In exchange for my hand in marriage, Gaven Belmonte is about to become the next head of the Price family. I've always tried to shun my family's past and their filthy ties to the underworld of organized crime. I don't smoke. I don't drink. I've never even had sex. I just want to be free, to be normal. Gaven could do more than just ruin that dream-he could completely annihilate me. It doesn't matter that I've been planning to escape my family's criminal past ever since the murder of my mother. What my father wants, he gets, and it appears the same is true for my new fiancé. He wants me, and he's about to get me. To have and to hold. Til' death do we part. We're a match made in hell, but the contract says that he owns me, body and soul, and he intends to make sure I know it.

title: Sante
description: In my capacity as Underboss of the Calabresi Mafia, I was respected and held in the same high esteem as my brother Savio, the Don of the family. The decision he made caused a chain reaction, and I made the decision to clean it all up. Unfortunately, it came with six-inch heels, red lipstick, and a mouth that likes to push all my buttons. A hate to love, enemies to lovers, arranged marriage, Dark Mafia romance, Book 2 in an interconnecting stand-alone series, and guaranteed to have an HEA.
